neighbours.label: The verb ' justify' / noun ' justification' and German rechtf-ert-igen, in any sense
fire: The company had to justify the price increase to its customers.
How can anyone justify spending that much on a single dinner?
The coach struggled to justify leaving his best player on the bench.
Der Minister musste sich vor dem Parlament rechtfertigen.
Scientists must justify each animal experiment to the ethics board.
There is no justification for treating patients that way.
You do not need to justify your choices to anyone.
Er versuchte, sein Verhalten vor Gericht zu rechtfertigen.
quiet: The company had to explain the price increase to its customers.
How can anyone afford spending that much on a single dinner?
The coach refused to discuss leaving his best player on the bench.
Der Minister musste sich vor dem Parlament entschuldigen.
Scientists must describe each animal experiment to the ethics board.
There is no place for rudeness when treating patients.
You do not need to explain your choices to anyone.
Er versuchte, sein Verhalten vor Gericht zu erklären.

notes: Card auto-test held as lexical. Probe: ' justify' 0.33-0.56 (typesetting sense 0.51 too, so it is the word, not the meaning), ' justification' 0.36, German rechtfertigen 1.00, 'legitimize' 0.50; adjective 'justified' only 0.14 so it is avoided; 'explain the reasons' 0.12, 'just' 0.06.
